mu_name_from: NPC/NpcSenatus.bmd, loaded as MODEL_NPC_SENATUS (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1961-1963, its textures out of Npc\), MuMain's MONSTER_SENIOR (GMBattleCastle.cpp:1384-1391), the elder of the Valley of Loren. Type 223, OpenMU's 'Senior' (VersionSeasonSix/NpcInitialization.cs:395-396). Not Version075's.
why_this_one: The Keeper of Kantur in Tarkan's safe hall, the user's pick (2026-10-06: 'lets use sonatus as keeper in Tarkan'; docs/tarkan-quest.md), after Tersia took the Lost Tower place he was first built for (2026-10-01). An old white-bearded man in a deep blue hooded robe with gold trim, holding a thin staff: 958 triangles on one 256 sheet, 52 bones, three clips.
scale_from: CreateCharacter stands him at `c->Object.Scale = 1.1f` (GMBattleCastle.cpp:1388), MU's own and not this mesh's: whoever stands him owes the 1.1, as a placement's scale. No lift, no BlendMesh, no subtype; NotRotateOnMagicHit is set and both weapon slots are empty (-1), so the staff is his mesh, not a held item.
actions_from: Three clips, all kept (export-rig --actions=all): action 0 seven keys, action 1 nineteen, action 2 thirteen. MuMain has no MoveCharacter or MoveCharacterVisual case for MODEL_NPC_SENATUS, so he plays them as any townsperson does, and no effect is owed.
sheet_from: Out of Data/NPC, beside the model, decoded under an npc_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: One page carrying his face, beard, robe, gold trim and staff together, so skin, as every townsperson's shared page does.
